cohort: Pregnant women who underwent caesarean section at AL Diwaniyah Maternity and Pediatric Hospital between December 26th 2020 to June 1st 2021
finding: The study found that caesarean section was associated with several complications, including postpartum hemorrhage, wound infection, postpartum infection, low Apgar score, respiratory distress syndrome, and perinatal asphyxia; education level and BMI were significantly associated with these complications.
